（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）

POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Shanghai Municipal Council.

14th January 1916

C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No 15
Date 14-1-16

Sir,
The French Police were notified by the Bureau of Foreign
Affairs both on the afternoon of the 12th and the afternoon
of the 13th that the rebels were going to attack the Chinese
Police Stations in the evening. Nothing happened.
More than the usual precautions were taken in the
Chinese City. The French Police have arrested a Government
detective who had an office and who is charged with
functioning in the French Concession.

The following in an extract from the Deusche Zeitung
fur China dated 13th January 1916:-
" Shanghai Elections.
We have nominated for the coming election Mr. Stepharius
as he is the oldest member of the German Community.
We could not nominate Mr.H.Figge for certain reasons.
We, Germans, in Shanghai have little chance of getting
a representative elected but we have shown that our interests
in China are not finished yet. "

Your Obedient Servant,

（签名）

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（印章：上海工部局）

警务处，
（侦探分部）

上海工部局。

1916年1月14日

刑事侦缉处
情报官登记
第15号
日期 16-1-14

先生：

法租界巡捕房于12日下午及13日下午两次接外务局通知，称叛军将于当晚袭击华界巡警局。但并未发生任何事件。

在华界已采取比平时更为严密的预防措施。法租界巡捕房逮捕了一名政府侦探，该侦探设有办事处，并被指控在法租界内活动。

以下为1916年1月13日《德文新报》（Deutsche Zeitung für China）摘录：
“上海选举。
我们提名施特法里乌斯（Stepharius）先生参加即将到来的选举，因为他是德国社群中最资深的成员。由于某些原因，我们无法提名H.菲格（Figge）先生。我们在上海的德国人几乎没有机会选出代表，但我们已表明，我们在中国的利益尚未终结。”

您顺从的仆人，

（签名）

总探长。

警务处总监。
